description: This file defines the internal error handler class for the Smarty templating engine. It manages error handling, particularly muting expected errors originating outside of the Smarty directory. The class provides methods to enable error muting and handle errors accordingly.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles internal error management for the Smarty templating system, including muting expected errors outside of the Smarty directory.

methods.name: muteExpectedErrors
methods.description: Enables the error handler to mute expected error messages, particularly those related to filemtime() calls outside the Smarty directory.

methods.name: mutingErrorHandler
methods.description: Custom error handler that mutes errors originating outside of the Smarty directory during error processing.
